ResponsesReasoning.title: ResponsesReasoning
ResponsesReasoning.description:
Native `reasoning.effort` plus the reviewed compatibility aliases.

The accepted profile decision requires Responses to take enablement, budget,
and visibility aliases, not effort alone, so an OpenRouter- or Codex-shaped
client resolves the same intent here that it already resolves on Chat
Completions and Messages. `max_tokens` is the budget alias; the total output
cap remains `max_output_tokens`.
